title: Separate elapsed-clock feature windows from observed-bar and gap-return effects
prior_why: The builders explicitly mix wall-clock returns with bar-count RV/range windows and gap-spanning increments. This can change scale estimates and selected tails.
mechanism: A weekend jump can enter a nominal one-minute volatility estimate, while 1440 observed bars span more than a day. Correctly timed scale/range features can change normalized signals and compression gates without adding information.
spec: Use development dates only, H=15, NY eligibility unchanged. Rebuild the base-66 own features with r1 missing unless adjacent closes are 60s apart; RV/range windows use elapsed minutes, require 80% observation coverage, and expose coverage masks. Use elapsed-time EMA decay. Compare original and rebuilt features on identical origins with identical fit-only imputation and masks supplied to both arms. Fit logistic and 256-landmark RBF heads; select mean-loss ridge {0.001,0.01,0.1} on three purged inner blocks. Separate calibration sets per-side 3% quantiles; evaluate all 15 refitted paths with strict ties and H de-overlap.
nearest_existing: e1t/e24cx/e52ck; R6-F1-01 and R6-G2-02 audit missingness; R6-K4-11 rescales existing inputs. None isolates elapsed-window/gap-return semantics.
fast_kill_falsifier: Kill the prediction branch if feature differences are negligible on NY origins, or neither head improves matched-coverage inner tail wins by 0.005. Record semantic discrepancies regardless.
cost: Estimated build M; 0.5–2 CPU h/pair including development rebuild and nested cheap heads.

title: Test the upper contract range directly: eight-hour and one-day settlement
prior_why: The stated program includes durations through one day, but completed tests stop at 30m and proposed rolling-duration tests at 240m. This is a change in forecasting scale.
mechanism: Slow relative currency drift, session transitions and daily return persistence may survive at long settlement horizons even when minute-scale direction is near noise. Support and blackout constraints may instead falsify feasibility.
spec: Register H={480,1440} minutes as separate keys, conditional on those duration contracts being available. Use actual entry+H endpoints wholly within development dates; preserve NY decisions and exact duration-specific blackout rules. First compute label-availability and de-overlap count ceilings; stop infeasible keys. Fit compact logistic on own/peer 15/60/240/1440m signed returns, causal RV and clock, with mean-loss ridge {0.001,0.01,0.1}. Select on three inner chronological blocks purged by actual label intervals; independent calibration selects side coverage {0.03,0.10}. Refit every outer path; retain the unchanged 25/12-of-15/p10 rule.
nearest_existing: e5h30/e49nys30; R6-K2-03 stops at 60/120/240m. R6-K2-11 is a fixed pre-close expiry, not an eight-hour or daily duration.
fast_kill_falsifier: Stop if contract/endpoint support cannot supply >=25 trades on 12 paths even at maximal eligible coverage, or both horizons lack positive inner tail uplift over clock-only controls.
cost: Estimated build M; 1–3 CPU h/pair for endpoint construction, nested logistic selection and 15 refits.

title: Learn sparse rule conjunctions with an honest penalized logistic readout
prior_why: Fixed rule offers and hand-picked interactions are covered. A sparse learned conjunction basis is absent and could retain a few useful setups with less variance than boosting.
mechanism: A rule such as a peer impulse combined with a target pullback can matter only in a narrow context. Sparse selection of complete conjunctions differs from averaging leaf frequencies or summing unrestricted boosting stages.
spec: H=15, base-66 features, approved development NY rows. Within each fit role, use the earlier 60% to generate 100 depth-2 CART trees on session bootstraps; purge H before the later 40% used for coefficients. Deduplicate path-conjunction rules and retain support 5–95%. Fit strict-UP/DOWN elastic-net logits on rule indicators plus standardized raw inputs, L1 fraction 0.5 and mean-loss penalties {0.001,0.01,0.1}. Repeat rule discovery inside each inner fit. Select penalty by three purged inner Brier blocks; untouched calibration sets side 3% quantiles. Compare ridge and honest-forest controls; all 15 outer refits, ties lose, H de-overlap.
nearest_existing: r4fixldn/r5fixecb/e87fixrank; R6-M1-02 freezes a dictionary and R6-M1-10 averages honest leaves. Neither sparsely selects learned conjunctions.
fast_kill_falsifier: Kill if selected conjunctions are unstable across inner blocks and neither strict-side Brier nor matched-count tail wins improve over both ridge and honest CART controls.
cost: Estimated build M; 0.5–2 CPU h/pair including nested rule construction.

title: Fit local PCA rotations before shallow bagged CART partitions
prior_why: All proposed tree growth/sampling variants still use axis-aligned partitions. Currency contrasts are correlated and can require many axis-aligned splits.
mechanism: Rotated splits can isolate a weak common-versus-idiosyncratic return contrast with fewer leaves. This is a preprocessing/tree combination; full-rank rotations of isotropic ridge or RBF models would not provide the same test.
spec: Use H=15, development NY base-66 features. Fit standardization on each fit role; leave clock, unsigned inputs and missingness masks unchanged. For eight fixed seeds partition signed columns into random blocks of six, fit full-rank PCA within each block, and rotate without truncation. Train 64 CART trees per rotation, max_depth=3, min_samples_leaf={1000,4000}, max_features=1.0, with session-bootstrap weights; average three-outcome probabilities. Match an unrotated 512-tree control. Select leaf floor on three purged inner Brier blocks; separate calibration sets side 3% cutoffs; score all 15 refits, ties lose and H de-overlap.
nearest_existing: e40forest; R6-M1-10 provides honest axis-aligned CART. R6-K4-11 and R6-P3-03 pair PCA with smooth heads, not shallow tree partitions.
fast_kill_falsifier: Kill unless rotation beats the equal-budget unrotated forest by >=0.005 mean inner tail win rate without worse strict-side Brier; novelty alone is insufficient.
cost: Estimated build M; 1–3 CPU h/pair for two matched forests with nested leaf selection.

title: Test persistent latent signed states against static mixture and volatility controls
prior_why: The existing HMM is a zero-mean calm/turbulent filter. Proposed signed return mixtures have no temporal state transitions. Persistent directional response regimes remain untested.
mechanism: The same current return/peer impulse may continue or reverse depending on a persistent latent state. Causal state posteriors can capture historical ordering that volatility states and static Gaussian mixtures discard.
spec: H=15, approved development NY decisions. Fit a two-state diagonal-covariance Gaussian HMM to observed normalized own/peer-basket 5m returns and log RV15/RV240, using permitted fit intervals only and separate sequence lengths. Fix diagonal transition prior 20 versus off-diagonal 1, covariance floor 0.001, 100 EM iterations and three fixed starts chosen by fit likelihood. Filter forward only; reset at gaps. Add state posterior and its interactions with own/peer 15m returns to strict-side ridge logits, penalty {0.001,0.01,0.1}. Inner purged Brier selects penalty; independent calibration sets 3% tails. Refit all 15 paths; compare raw, static-mixture and volatility-state controls.
nearest_existing: e24cx/e21kf; R6-M1-24 models switching scale and R6-M2-18 models static conditional return mixtures. Neither learns persistent signed-state responses.
fast_kill_falsifier: Kill if states collapse or mostly duplicate RV, or filtered states fail to improve matched-count inner tail wins by 0.005 over static-mixture and existing volatility-state controls.
cost: Estimated build M; 1–4 CPU h/pair for bounded HMM fits and nested ridge heads.

title: Cross existing alternative labels with the strongest low-variance model families
prior_why: tb2 and residual labels were tested with LightGBM. Their failure does not establish failure with logistic/kernel heads, which often beat the booster on these keys.
mechanism: Alternative supervision may be useful only with stronger shrinkage: a smooth model can average noisy barrier/residual targets without manufacturing extreme tails. Conversely, target mismatch may make every such combination fail.
spec: Register H=15 and labels {settlement sign,tb2,resid}, crossed with standardized logistic and 256-landmark RBF logistic heads. Build residual nuisance estimates inside each fit role; use only permitted, fully matured outcomes. Compare on common finite-label fit rows, plus a full-population sign control. Use mean-loss penalties {0.001,0.01,0.1}; fix RBF gamma from median fit distances. Rebuild labels/transforms inside each of three purged inner splits. Select label/head/penalty using raw strict-settlement Brier after separate calibration, never alternate-label accuracy. Final independent calibration sets side 3% cutoffs; all 15 refits retain ties and H de-overlap.
nearest_existing: e8tb2/e28resid are LightGBM; e69agreenys tests only agreement labels on two pairs. R6-K4-05 races model/representation settings, not this label cross.
fast_kill_falsifier: Kill an alternative label if no head beats its matched-row sign control by 0.005 inner tail wins, or any apparent gain disappears against the full-row sign control.
cost: Estimated build S–M; 0.5–2 CPU h/pair including nested nuisance labels and cheap heads.

title: Learn a tiny continuation model for admission under the horizon cooldown
prior_why: Greedy de-overlap creates an opportunity cost. Existing episode gates and fixed waits do not learn it; the old RL family supplies caution, not this discrete test.
mechanism: An early qualifying offer can block a better forecast for H minutes. A small continuation-value model may decide when to wait while preserving the same frozen direction forecasts and exact contract payoff.
spec: H=15; reuse honest strict-side forecasts from R6-E-01. For each pair/side bin issued scores at fit quantiles {0,0.5,0.8,0.9,0.97,1}. On inner OOF NY streams estimate adjacent-minute transition counts with Dirichlet mass 100 and strict-win reward per bin minus 0.541. Solve the five-state finite-session trade/wait Bellman recursion: trade blocks H minutes, wait blocks one; session-end continuation is zero. Gate current quantile offers by trade advantage >={0,0.005}, using only current state and learned transitions. Select margin on purged inner policy replay; independent calibration matches baseline counts. Compare greedy and fixed-delay policies on all 15 refits.
nearest_existing: R6-G2-03 tests episode/grid entry; R6-G2-06 waits for a fixed retracement; R6-L-16 uses single-step payoff loss. No fitted cooldown continuation model is specified.
fast_kill_falsifier: Kill if the policy loses required path support or fails to gain 0.005 matched-count inner strict-win rate over both greedy and fixed-delay controls. Never use later test offers in decisions.
cost: Estimated build M; <0.2 CPU h/pair after honest caches, excluding parent forecast fits.

summary: The taxonomy was written before reading proposals, then refined to expose seven combination/model gaps. Read all 353 proposal rows, all 110 inventory blocks, harness options, feature/label code and repository method menus. The union is broad: ordinary neural/tabular/sequence families, denoising, pooling, distributional labels, weighting, honest stacking, calibration, causal replay and whole-search multiplicity already have tests or explicit proposals. Highest priorities among the residual gaps are elapsed-clock feature semantics and direct 8h/1d contracts; sparse rules, rotated trees, signed-state persistence, alternative-label/low-variance combinations and cooldown continuation are lower-prior bounded screens. Generic GP/GNN/Mamba, focal-loss, conformal and booster-name permutations were not treated as automatically worthwhile new tests. TESTED means inventory evidence, not older-vendor closure or a queued run. Reconcile e20sg/USDCHF UP (14/15, p10 0.551) with the no-pass context through the existing verdict audit. No files were changed; no network connections, excluded-data reads or model fits were made.
